title: Family presence
description: Who of the household is at home, heading home or out, in the header. A service on the home PC reads OwnTracks from the phones, applies everybody's own privacy mode and sends only a short status (no coordinates).

personal.question: Show in the header whether you are at home, heading home or out? Your phone sends your location to the home PC (OwnTracks); the others see only the status you allow in your chip.

isolationReason: the receiver takes OwnTracks points from the phones over a public HTTPS address of the home PC
